lines: > **pre-flight #285:** ⛔ NOT CAPTURED — UNMEASURED. Reason unchanged from #199…#284: this is a DELEGATED wrap, and the seat that would have priced the ritual is not the seat that ran it. The conductor DECLARED his FILL at the brief cut (191,785 real / 28 turns) and that figure is carried on the `wrap-handover` line below as `brief-cut`, where it belongs; it is not a pre-flight estimate and is not laundered into one [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]].

> **POST-MORTEM #285 — measured, not narrated.** ⚙ **TWO OBJECTS, REPORTED SEPARATELY, NEVER SUMMED AND NEVER AVERAGED** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]. **(1) THE CONDUCTOR'S WINDOW, first-hand at this seat against `62add8e4-a016-4881-9b21-af4571354a1e.jsonl` — the session's TOP-LEVEL transcript, this wrap seat being `agent-a1d288ef03329a515.jsonl` beneath it: FILL 197,852 real across 31 turns, first-turn 80,863 real (n=1).** ⛔ **THE 180,000 STOP LINE WAS PASSED BY 17,852** and ✅ **the close sits 22,148 INSIDE the ≤220,000 tolerance**; ✅ **256,000 was not reached, the THIRD session running.** ⚠ **Per Dave's own #284 correction the 180,000 is the QUALITY line and the 256,000 figure is not a wall for this model in Cowork** — so this is a quality breach and **no constant moved.** ⛔ **THE FIRST-TURN FIGURE IS THE TENTH POST-DIET READING OVER `BOOT_CEILING_TK` 70,000 AND IS NOT A RE-BASE:** the literal is SHRINK-ONLY by `s240-D2`/`s241-D1`, the remedy is to CUT THE BOOT, and raising it is Dave's word alone. ★ **It is also, for the first time in ten, a figure with a lever aimed at it** — he blocked the built-in Browser's 17 tools, so #286 reads boot cold with ONE variable changed. **(2) THE SEVEN LANES, a QUOTA object and never a fill reading** — on the `subs` line below.

> **⚠ THE `subs` LINE ABOVE IS QUOTA, NEVER FILL** [[budget-vs-quota-vocabulary]] — seven delegated Opus seats, each figure its own last-turn resident reading measured at this wrap seat from `subagents/*.jsonl`: LM2 the masters regen **154,244** · V the adversarial verifier **117,752** · C the commit lane **113,858** · C2 the showroom commit **94,747** · SC the seam standing block **89,857** · W attempt 1 **90,605** (it DIED; its peak is the honest figure and it is counted, because it spent the quota) · P the push lane **77,788**. ⚠ **A SECOND, DIFFERENTLY-DEFINED FIGURE IS PUBLISHED RATHER THAN RECONCILED: summing every `message.usage` record across the seven transcripts reads 36,298,143** — that counts cache re-reads at every turn and is a different object from the seven resident readings above. **Neither is scaled to match the other and neither is added to the block's fill numbers** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]. The convention this log has used since #284 is the last-turn resident reading, and that is the one on the `subs` line.

> **wrap-handover: brief-cut 191,785 real (conductor, DECLARED in the #285 wrap brief as his last `_seam.py` reading, 28 turns) · sub-cut 197,852 real (first-hand, this seat, 31 turns) · delta 6,067 real · replay unobservable (conductor-side, post-wrap)**

> **⚠ THE `delta` ABOVE IS A LEGAL SUBTRACTION AND THE NAMED WINDOW IS WHY.** The `s214-D5` clause homed at the #272 wrap says `delta` is meaningful ONLY when both terms read the SAME window. They do: `_checkin.py`'s transcript glob resolves to the conductor's own top-level `62add8e4-…jsonl` — there is exactly one `.jsonl` at that level and the eight subagent logs sit in `subagents/` beneath it — so `sub-cut` measures the window `brief-cut` describes. ✅ **The declared and the measured first-turn figures agree TO THE TOKEN — the figure itself is stated once, above, and is deliberately not restated here (`s241-D2`) — and that agreement is the independent evidence that it is the same window.** ⚠ **`replay` is NOT observable from inside a sub** and is written as the honest form; the conductor may append the measured figure at the #286 opener.

> **⚠ DECLARED SKIPS AND NOT-DONE AT THIS WRAP, EACH NAMED WITH ITS SIZE** (declare-last, and the size is the point). **2c, 2d and 2f ALL RAN** — no `size:` stamp is being carried forward from #284 and nothing here is a prior session's figure. **2e is a NO-OP at 0 lines:** DO-FIRST minted no supersession notice, no closure tombstone and no lifecycle tag, and ⛔ **nothing was retro-tagged**, which would be a rewrite of ratified text. ⛔ **FENCED FROM THIS WRAP AND UNTOUCHED:** `_gauge_tokens.py` constants (the 256,000 wording fix is Dave's to order and is carried, not made), `gen_kg_icons.py`, `gen_kg_rules.py`, `land_rests_on.py`, `_build_all.py`, and any ruling inscription — `knowledge/_rulings.json` reads **620** by `json.load` at the open and at the close. ⚠ **NOT REPAIRED AND DECLARED:** `carry_wording_check()` is BLIND — both residual lines are pointers, so it has nothing to pair and goes quiet rather than loud; re-pointing it at `_CARRIES.md`'s two newest sections is OWED (`notes/_subreports/2026-08-30-225-carries-home.md`). ⚠ **`_gate_scratch_hygiene.py` still prints `VM disk fill 48.9%`, which is `/` and NOT the `/sessions` volume the leak it exists to police lives on** — #283 named it, #284 carried it, and it is not fixed here because changing an instrument's reported mount changes what it claims. ⚠ **`_seam.py`'s SCRATCH arm deletes a lane's own `/tmp` working files mid-run, by design** (lane V's carried note); not fixed, for the same reason — this wrap's defence was a convention, every ops file under `notes/_lanes/285/W/`, not a guard.
> **section-usage #285 (self-report, delegated OPUS 5 wrap sub):** GM HDR:C LATEST:C PRIOR:R DOFIRST:U A:U C1:U C2:U C4:U STRATA:C · LS HDR:C DELTAS:C LANES:U LIVE:U OPEN:U

> The wrap WROTE the header, the ★ LATEST banner, the ⏱ delta and the strata; READ the ★ PRIOR banner to roll it and to run the EXIT CHECK over it; and left §A, DO-FIRST, §C and the standing `_LIVE-STATE` regions UNREAD and UNTOUCHED. ⚠ **§A was not read and was not edited — it is standing and exempt (GM-D7-am), and the mover asserts its sha256 before and after every projected write.** The digest read `4311cce4…` at this seat over the gate's OWN pinned probe shape (`_capture_gate.section_a_digest`), **byte-identical to what all thirteen stamps from #272 to #284 recorded — §A has not moved in SEVENTEEN sessions.** ⚠ **THE TWO-PROBE-SHAPE QUESTION #272 RAISED IS STILL NOT SETTLED AND IS NOT SETTLED HERE** — #269/#270/#271 recorded `b9aef5f5…` over 169 lines and #272…#285 record `4311cce4…` over 198; two probe shapes, not a change in §A, and **which shape the stamp should quote is ruling-shaped and remains Dave's, now at its seventeenth session.**

> **consult-receipts #285:** none — no `_memento_search.py` query was run at this seat. Every source this ritual used was named by the brief, by the runbook or by a filed lane report and was read directly by path; the honest negative is recorded rather than a query invented to satisfy the probe [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]].

> **⚠ THE `section-sizes` LINE BELOW IS `_gm_usage.py`'s INSTRUMENT AND IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT FROM THE `size:` STAMP'S WHOLE-FILE FIGURE** — the stamp measures the whole file with `tiktoken cl100k_base` and this line measures per-section with the usage tool's own spans, so the two do not sum to one another and neither is scaled to match. Both are published; neither is reconciled.

> **section-sizes #285 (real):** GM HDR:3072 LATEST:932 PRIOR:948 DOFIRST:10140 A:6957 C1:2927 C2:1769 C4:11926 STRATA:7063 · LS HDR:13553 LANES:1598 SPIN:5252 DELTAS:11704 WEBFONT:939 LIVE:7886 LIFECYCLE:1017 DEAD:678 OPEN:38604 TARGETS:896 SPINOFFS:728 · totals GM:45734 LS:82855

> **⚠ `s214-D6` BANNER-DISCIPLINE MEASUREMENT — QUOTED FROM `_CHAIN.md`'s GENERATED FOOTER, NEVER RE-DERIVED, AND TAKEN AFTER THE DECLARE-LAST `size:` STAMP BECAUSE THE STAMP IS ITSELF INSIDE THE CHAIN SLICE** (the #241 rule, from #240's one-wrap-two-figures lesson): S214D6_FIGURE. ⚠ **The related #240 defect is NOT repaired and both numbers are reported rather than a third invented:** `grep -c 'BANNER-DISCIPLINE MEASUREMENT' notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` and the newest ORDINAL named in that file disagree by two — the count is re-derivable, the naming is not.

> **⚠ AND THE BANNER'S HEADROOM, MEASURED RATHER THAN FEARED — THIS IS THE FOURTH WRAP RUNNING TO SAY SO.** The ★ LATEST banner closed at **1,196 cl100k over 10 of 10 substantive lines** against the `s241-D2` cap of 1,200 / 10, reached in FIVE measured compression passes (1,225 → 1,240 with the real GENERATED line substituted for a short placeholder → 1,228 → 1,196) with **nothing dropped** — the clause commands SHORTER, never decide-what-to-drop. ★ **One of those passes exists only because the GENERATED residual line was measured at its REAL expected width instead of a placeholder: a figure taken before the step that writes it is a prediction, not a measurement** (the #240 lesson, met from the other direction). ⛔ **#272…#284's standing warning that the next wrap has no room in this idiom is NOT withdrawn, and the cap is Dave's.**

> **COMMIT STATE #285:** ⬛ **THE HASH IS A DECLARED GAP IN THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE — A COMMIT CANNOT NAME ITSELF.** This wrap's commit sha is delivered in the returned report and is readable from `git log`. ⛔ **THE TREE WAS NOT IN SYNC WHEN THIS RITUAL OPENED: TWO lane commits stood UNPUSHED — `b99d092c` (the LM2 masters regen + the SC seam STANDING block) and `ff354475` (the showroom re-sync, 108 pages, and the `W-285lm` row amended with Dave's acceptance)** — and the P lane's push **refused, correctly**, on a dirty tree (`✗ push refused: tree not clean — commit first (s133-D2; rehearsal log excluded per s137-D1)`), because three paths belonging to other lanes were outstanding and P was forbidden to commit. This wrap commits them and pushes all three. ⛔ **SIX BLOCKING GATE FAILS STAND AND THIS COMMIT TAKES THE `#243` DECLARED NOT-A-WRAP PATH — THE ELEVENTH CONSECUTIVE WRAP TO DO SO.** Every one is another session's append-only testimony in this file — the boot-drift CEILING BREACH and five boot double-counts (#243, #264, #272, #273, #274) — and **a wrap may not repair an inherited gate fail**: the ceiling's remedy is to CUT THE BOOT, never to raise the literal, and raising it is Dave's word alone [[gate-must-quote-what-it-forbids]]. ⚠ **A SEVENTH STOOD AT THE OPEN AND WAS THIS SEAT'S OWN, CLOSED BEFORE THE ROLLS: `ds-021 (C)` fired on `knowledge/_seam.py`**, which gained a cl100k counting site (`standing_tokens()`) in **this session's own commit `b99d092c`** and was never registered. Entered in `MEASURERS` as **`estimate-only`** — it never calls `_gauge_tokens.count()`, has no API path, and its figure is never a FILL or budget claim — following the `_compose_slice.py` precedent set at the #270 wrap. ⛔ **A DECLARATION, NOT A RULING.** ⚠ **`SHOWROOM_ACK` SHOULD NO LONGER BE NEEDED: the showroom was re-synced in `ff354475` and the `s191-D1` gate should pass clean** — this wrap's own commit is the first test of that, and it is stated as a prediction until the run measures it. ⚠ **TWO INSTRUMENTATION APPENDS (`notes/_REHEARSAL-LOG.jsonl`, `notes/_dream/_GRADE-DECISIONS.jsonl`) stood in the tree at the brief cut and more accrued DURING this ritual**, because `_checkin.py` and the wrap gate write to them as they run; they are committed with this wrap and named here, exactly as #282, #283 and #284 did, and **the POLICY on them is still Dave's (dream pass 6 P2, floated)**. ⚠ **AND THE RITUAL ITSELF IS A FINDING THIS TIME: THE FIRST WRAP SUB DIED MID-RITUAL** — five reads, 90,605 real, `API Error: Can't reach the API server — check your internet or DNS (ENOTFOUND)` at 14:52:22Z — **and it had written nothing, so this retry opened on a tree exactly as the lanes left it.** ⛔ **That is luck, not design**, and whether the ritual owes a RESUME contract is ruling-shaped and NOT inscribed.
